name: set_world_flag

stack.evidence: func_001D8E90 reads world index and flag-bit index from the Script stack in that order, passes them to func_0013C098, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: func_0013C098 selects the 116-byte world-state record at world_index, sets flag_bit in its byte at offset 0x74, and additionally records newly set world-zero bit indices in a three-byte tracking area. The six JP calls set bit 3 or 5 for world index 0 or 1.
